From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: POC timeline & next steps (Aurora Systems)

Hi Jared / Priya —

Great to speak with you this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:  

Recap / Success criteria (as discussed):
- Latency: 95th percentile inference latency under 350ms for batch sizes typical to your agent workflows.
- Cost: token cost per 1k requests below your internal target (we'll validate with sample traffic).
- Accuracy: end-to-end quality measured against the 200-sample test set you shared: >92% intent match and <5% hallucination rate on key prompts.
- Operational: SSO + audit logs in place and PI data flows limited to dedicated environment.

Proposed evaluation plan / milestones:
1) Kickoff & onboarding (Week 0): environment access, dataset ingestion, baseline run. Owner: Marissa / Dev.
2) Integration & tuning (Weeks 1–3): run sample traffic, iterate batching/quantization settings. Owner: Dev Patel.
3) Weekly readouts (Weeks 1–4): 30-min check-ins on metrics and blockers. Owner: Neha.
4) Final readout & handoff (End of Week 4): summary, cost/latency tradeoffs, go/no-go decision. Owner: Marissa.

Proposed timeline (start week of 2027-04-26):
- Kickoff: Wed 2027-04-28 (30–45 min)
- Weekly check-ins: Wednesdays 10am PT, starting 2027-05-05
- Final readout: Wed 2027-05-26

Attachments: POC plan template and SOW draft attached for your review (20270418-POC-plan-Aurora.pdf, 20270418-SOW-draft.docx).

Action items / asks for you:
- Confirm the success criteria above or call out any changes.
- Send the sample 200-item eval set and a representative API key / enclave details so we can validate data ingest.
- Confirm kickoff availability 2027-04-28 or propose an alternate.

I'll get the kickoff invite out once you confirm. Thanks again — excited to get this running.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference
